{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module LogAgent where

import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import qualified Data.HashMap.Strict as HM
import Data.Hashable (Hashable(..))
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock (UTCTime, getCurrentTime)
import Data.List (foldl')
import Control.Monad (when, forM_)

-- Role-based access control
data Role = Admin | Auditor | Service | Guest deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)

data User = User
  { userName :: Text
  , userRole :: Role
  , userToken :: Text
  } deriving (Eq, Show)

data LogEntry = LogEntry
  { logTimestamp :: UTCTime
  , logSource :: Text
  , logMessage :: Text
  , logTags :: [Text]
  , logSeverity :: Int
  } deriving (Show)

-- Tag index for fast lookup by tag
type TagIndex = HM.HashMap Text [Int]

data LogStore = LogStore
  { storeEntries :: IORef (Map.Map Int LogEntry)
  , storeTagIndex :: IORef TagIndex
  , storeNextId :: IORef Int
  , storeUsers :: IORef (Map.Map Text User)
  }

-- Custom tag key type for normalized lookup
newtype TagKey = TagKey { unTagKey :: Text } deriving (Eq, Show)

-- Hash instance that normalizes case for "case-insensitive" matching
-- This creates a hash function where many distinct inputs collide
instance Hashable TagKey where
  hashWithSalt salt (TagKey t) = hashWithSalt salt (T.toLower t)

initStore :: IO LogStore
initStore = do
  entries <- newIORef Map.empty
  tagIdx <- newIORef HM.empty
  nextId <- newIORef 0
  users <- newIORef $ Map.fromList
    [ ("admin-token", User "admin" Admin "admin-token")
    , ("auditor-token", User "auditor" Auditor "auditor-token")
    , ("service-token", User "svc" Service "service-token")
    ]
  return $ LogStore entries tagIdx nextId users

authenticate :: LogStore -> Text -> IO (Maybe User)
authenticate store token = do
  users <- readIORef (storeUsers store)
  return $ Map.lookup token users

canWrite :: Role -> Bool
canWrite Admin = True
canWrite Service = True
canWrite _ = False

canRead :: Role -> Bool
canRead Admin = True
canRead Auditor = True
canRead Service = True
canRead Guest = False

-- Insert a log entry with tag indexing
-- The tag index uses HashMap for O(1) average lookup
insertLog :: LogStore -> Text -> LogEntry -> IO (Either Text Int)
insertLog store token entry = do
  mUser <- authenticate store token
  case mUser of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Authentication failed"
    Just user ->
      if canWrite (userRole user)
        then do
          entryId <- readIORef (storeNextId store)
          modifyIORef' (storeNextId store) (+1)
          modifyIORef' (storeEntries store) (Map.insert entryId entry)
          -- Index each tag for fast retrieval
          forM_ (logTags entry) $ \tag -> do
            modifyIORef' (storeTagIndex store) $ \idx ->
              HM.insertWith (++) tag [entryId] idx
          return $ Right entryId
        else return $ Left "Insufficient permissions"

-- Query logs by tag - uses HashMap lookup
queryByTag :: LogStore -> Text -> Text -> IO (Either Text [LogEntry])
queryByTag store token tag = do
  mUser <- authenticate store token
  case mUser of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Authentication failed"
    Just user ->
      if canRead (userRole user)
        then do
          tagIdx <- readIORef (storeTagIndex store)
          entries <- readIORef (storeEntries store)
          let entryIds = HM.lookupDefault [] tag tagIdx
          let results = [e | eid <- entryIds, Just e <- [Map.lookup eid entries]]
          return $ Right results
        else return $ Left "Insufficient permissions"

-- Bulk tag search: find entries matching ALL provided tags
-- This performs intersection of tag result sets
bulkTagSearch :: LogStore -> Text -> [Text] -> IO (Either Text [LogEntry])
bulkTagSearch store token tags = do
  mUser <- authenticate store token
  case mUser of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Authentication failed"
    Just user ->
      if canRead (userRole user)
        then do
          tagIdx <- readIORef (storeTagIndex store)
          entries <- readIORef (storeEntries store)
          -- For each tag, get the entry IDs, then intersect
          let tagSets = map (\t -> HM.lookupDefault [] t tagIdx) tags
          let commonIds = case tagSets of
                [] -> []
                (x:xs) -> foldl' intersectSorted x xs
          let results = [e | eid <- commonIds, Just e <- [Map.lookup eid entries]]
          return $ Right results
        else return $ Left "Insufficient permissions"

intersectSorted :: [Int] -> [Int] -> [Int]
intersectSorted [] _ = []
intersectSorted _ [] = []
intersectSorted (x:xs) (y:ys)
  | x == y = x : intersectSorted xs ys
  | x < y  = intersectSorted xs (y:ys)
  | otherwise = intersectSorted (x:xs) ys

-- Aggregate metrics: count entries per tag using HashMap accumulation
-- An attacker with Service role can craft tags that cause hash collisions
-- degrading HashMap from O(1) to O(n) per operation
computeMetrics :: LogStore -> Text -> IO (Either Text (HM.HashMap Text Int))
computeMetrics store token = do
  mUser <- authenticate store token
  case mUser of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Authentication failed"
    Just user ->
      if canRead (userRole user)
        then do
          entries <- readIORef (storeEntries store)
          let allTags = concatMap logTags (Map.elems entries)
          -- Accumulate counts in HashMap - vulnerable to hash collision attack
          let counts = foldl' (\acc t -> HM.insertWith (+) t 1 acc) HM.empty allTags
          return $ Right counts
        else return $ Left "Insufficient permissions"
